title: ticfac still carries the tk exit-8 width machinery that ticks 7.0.0 retired
body: The re-vendored tk-json-manifest.json (ticks bundle 7.0.0) says tk never refuses a claim for width any more: the wave-width gate and its exit 8 left tk with the runner, and the orchestrator that owns the width caps dispatch itself. ticfac still carries ErrDispatchWidth (internal/tk), the RefusedClaimWidth hold (internal/reconcile, self-described as 'should be unreachable from the run's own arithmetic') and dispatch-window handling whose only producer is now a test fake. Harmless but dead: a tick should verify ticfac's own width arithmetic is the sole authority the 7.0.0 manifest names and shrink or re-comment the exit-8 path accordingly.
